completeness.reason: The parent's only externally visible obligation (CCS2 inlet per IEC 62196-3) is covered.

consistency.reason: No other element satisfies REQ_EU_CHARGING_STANDARD; the NA twin CCS1 is mutually exclusive by region gating.

design_clarity.reason: Inlet type, standard and session protocol (ISO 15118-2) are concrete, but 'sets the charging current limit from the BMS cell limits' names no derivation or which BMS limits are used.
design_clarity.suggestion: State how the current limit is derived (e.g. which BMS limit signals, min() with the power/voltage bound used by SWREQ_CHG_CURRENT_LIMIT).

implementability.suggestion: Align the current-limit statement with SWREQ_CHG_CURRENT_LIMIT or name both bounds explicitly.

no_value_copy.reason: Names no BMS limit, threshold or timing value; only refers to 'BMS cell limits' generically.

parent_fit.reason: REQ_EU_CHARGING_STANDARD asks for a CCS2 inlet per IEC 62196-3; the element chooses exactly a CCS2 inlet (IEC 62196-3).

variant_consistency.reason: Gated by `if var.market.region == 'eu'` inside the bev-only subsystems/chg folder; parent lives in region/eu, so the gating is equal (eu) plus stronger (bev), in variant vocabulary.

summary: CCS2 element satisfies the EU inlet requirement and is correctly gated (eu + bev folder); the current-limit derivation is left loose.
